{"success": true, "data": {"stdout": "#!/bin/bash
# Gamma-sweep watchdog: chains g080 -> g095 -> g100 after g050 finishes
# Monitors PID and auto-launches next gamma value on completion

export TORCH_COMPILE_DISABLE=1
export CUDA_VISIBLE_DEVICES=2,3
export TMPDIR=/root/autodl-tmp/tmp
export WANDB_DIR=/root/autodl-tmp/wandb
export WANDB_TMPDIR=/root/autodl-tmp/tmp

source /root/miniconda3/etc/profile.d/conda.sh
conda activate base

cd /root/cost-verify-agent-rl/RAGEN

GAMMAS=("080" "095" "100")
CURRENT_PID=85798
SEED=1
TRAIN_SEED=10000
LOG_DIR="/root/runs/cost-verify-agent-rl"

mkdir -p "$LOG_DIR"

echo "[$(date)] gsweep_watchdog started"
echo "[$(date)] Waiting for g050 (PID $CURRENT_PID) to finish first"

for g in "${GAMMAS[@]}"; do
    echo "[$(date)] Polling PID $CURRENT_PID (sleep 60s intervals)..."
    while kill -0 $CURRENT_PID 2>/dev/null; do
        sleep 60
    done
    echo "[$(date)] PID $CURRENT_PID exited. Launching gamma=g${g}"

    CONFIG="_alfworld_gamma_sweep_g${g}_h5"
    EXP_NAME="gsweep-g${g}-h5-seed${SEED}"
    EXP_LOG="${LOG_DIR}/${EXP_NAME}.log"

    python train.py --config-name "$CONFIG" \
        seed.train=$TRAIN_SEED \
        trainer.experiment_name="$EXP_NAME" \
        2>&1 | tee "$EXP_LOG" &
    CURRENT_PID=$!

    echo "[$(date)] Started gamma=g${g} EXP=$EXP_NAME PID=$CURRENT_PID"
done

echo "[$(date)] Waiting for final run (PID $CURRENT_PID)..."
wait $CURRENT_PID
echo "[$(date)] All gamma sweeps complete!"

export CUDA_VISIBLE_DEVICES=2,3

SEED=1
TRAIN_SEED=10000
LOG_DIR="/root/runs/cost-verify-agent-rl"

mkdir -p "$LOG_DIR"

echo "[$(date)] gsweep_watchdog started"
echo "[$(date)] Waiting for g050 (PID $CURRENT_PID) to finish first"

for g in "${GAMMAS[@]}"; do
    echo "[$(date)] Polling PID $CURRENT_PID (sleep 60s intervals)..."
    while kill -0 $CURRENT_PID 2>/dev/null; do
        sleep 60
    done
    echo "[$(date)] PID $CURRENT_PID exited. Launching gamma=g${g}"

    EXP_NAME="gsweep-g${g}-h5-seed${SEED}"

        seed.train=$TRAIN_SEED \
        trainer.experiment_name="$EXP_NAME" \
        2>&1 | tee "$EXP_LOG" &
    CURRENT_PID=$!

    echo "[$(date)] Started gamma=g${g} EXP=$EXP_NAME PID=$CURRENT_PID"
done

echo "[$(date)] All gamma sweeps complete!"
